  Notices
  An invitation is one file for one newcomer. It holds the plan, their
  preparation, an empty record, and their first steps guide.

  This tool sends nothing. Give the file to the newcomer yourself, through a
  channel your organization approves.

  Add a person, or fix a preparation, on the Preparation tab. This list checks
  everyone again each time it opens.
